notes: The product itself is right. It shows a pave bow with an open loop and knot, a pave circle, and the pearl sitting low in the circle, in rhodium silver tone. It is worn through the lobe, where it really sits, with the circle hanging just below the lobe as in listing photo 3. No hands in frame.

Scale is within tolerance. The ear measures ~620 px from helix top to lobe (60 mm), giving ~10.3 px/mm. The stud is ~175 px tall, so ~17 mm against 18 mm listed.

Camp colour is weak after the crop. Only ~2.5% of pixels are lilac (the top-left corner and a sliver at the left edge), against ~34% in uncropped a2. The frame reads mostly as black hair and skin, which is borderline on rule 7. A tighter crop of a2 would not fix this. Cropping at x>=540 (to clear the lashes) with the bottom at y<=1645 (to keep out the rounded under-jaw at a2 y ~1730-1930) leaves only ~0.7% lilac.
fix: Re-shoot. A re-crop cannot both clear the face and keep the lilac. Frame a rear three-quarter / back-of-head view with the face turned fully away, so no brow, eyelashes, eye, nose, lips, chin or rounded under-jaw enters the frame. Leave a clear margin of at least ~5% of frame width between the frame edge and the face profile. Put a lilac backdrop behind the neck and/or a lilac top at the bottom of the frame so lilac makes up a visible share of the frame. Keep everything else as it is: a single stud worn through the lobe, the pave bow and open pave circle in rhodium silver, and an ivory/warm-cream pearl sitting low in the circle, ~18 mm tall (about 30% of ear height).
